publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: With reduced feature sizes and tighter pitches in deep submicro, yield loss caused by spot defect becomes much more significant in determing manufacturing yield. Successful designs of defect-tolerant chips must rely on the accurate and fast yield prediction. This paper proposes an improved alternative approach based on the equidistance line in L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> metric to compute the critical areas. It is very efficient especially for small layouts.

articleTitle: A T-S fuzzy ranging model used in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Wireless Sensor node location is very important for communication in Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). The accuracy of ranging significantly affects the accuracy of localization of the node. However, WSN nodes are often randomly fixed in an unknown environment. Traditional ranging model depend on the environment parameter too much. Considering the effect of these factors, this paper presents an adaptive Fuzzy TS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> ranging model (FUZZY-TS). The simulation experiment indicates that this method is feasible and effective for improving ranging accuracy and will help to improve the accuracy of localization of node.

articleTitle: A novel dynamic CAPTCHA based on inverted colors
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: CAPTCHA (also known as verification code) is mainly used to guarantee the login security of the interactive websites. At present, the most popular verification code is image CAPTCHA which can distinguish the human user from the computer by identifying characters in the image. Although the image CAPTCHA is safe at beginning, great deals of CAPTCHAs have been cracked by the computers along with the development of image processing technology and artificial intelligence technology. This paper presents a new dynamic CAPTCHA based on inverted color. The characters color and the background color in the CAPTCHA are inverted respectively, the interference lines are added in the foreground image and multi-frame dynamic images are compounded to ensure the CAPTCHA has better visual effects, and thus, it is easy for the human to identity the real information while hard to remove the interference information by normal image processing technology. Theoretical analysis and simulation experiments prove that the CAPTCHA is safe and efficient.

articleTitle: On existence results of generalized strong vector equilibrium problem
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, a generalized strong vector equilibrium problem is introduced and studied. By making use of C(x)-continuity and FKKM theory, some existence theorems of the solutions to the generalized strong vector equilibrium problem are obtained. The results presented here extend the corresponding results in this area.

articleTitle: The research of intelligent equalization charging technology for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Because of the imbalances between the series-connected cells during the charging will greatly reduce the battery packs cycle life, charge equalization has become important consideration in the serially connected battery cells charging technology. To improve the unbalance of the series-connected battery packs and guarantee that the voltage of all battery cells is at the same level in the battery packs, this paper present an intelligent equalization charging technology which consisted of charging function module, nondestructive equalization device, and intelligent equalizing charge strategy to realize the intelligent equalizing charging between the series connected cells. This technology can be used for improving the level of consistency of the tandem battery and transferring energy effectively equilibrium between single battery. This paper will introduce the intelligent equalization charging technology by three parts, and it can help reader to familiar with this theory and technology easier.

articleTitle: Parallel agent-based simulation of complex system based on repast HPC
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Repast for High Performance Computing (Repast HPC) is a toolkit for Parallel Agent-Based Simulation (PABS). Repast core concepts are introduced briefly firstly, and on the basis, new characters added to Repast HPC to fulfill the demands of parallel simulation are described with emphases. Finally, the space target system is used as a case to expound the simulation implementation process. And from the process and result, the effectiveness of PABS and Repast HPC is reflected.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Nodes

articleTitle: Simulator design and lab scale test of a gas filling station for Geiger Muller detectors
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The paper presents the creation of a simulator for the Geiger Muller (GM) gas filling station. It simulates the entire gas filling process, from preparing for gas filling by vacuuming out the system to adding in different gases and sealing the detector. The simulator not only demonstrates the overall gas filling process, but also identifies certain steps that can be automated to speed up the process and reduce human error. An easy-to-use human-machine interface is created so that the operator is informed of the current state of the system and the operations that need to be performed manually. A lab scale bench top test is set up to demonstrate the implementation of the automated process. It shows that a Compact RIO system running on real-time environment can be used to communicate with the computer and control a motor. Finally, in order to integrate the simulator with the current gas filling station, the improvements that need to be made on the current station are identified.

articleTitle: Construction of the network courseware quality evaluation index system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and its application in the educational informatization, network courseware has become one of the important resources for network teaching and played an significant role in it. Firstly, the article analyzes that the network courseware making must conform to the general requirement of multimedia courseware, embody the theory of constructivism learning and reflect the basic requirement of self-directed learning. And then the article proposes the fundamental principles of network courseware quality evaluation index system including practicability, scientificalness, adaptability, comprehensive, instructive, collaboration and so on. Finally, it constructs the network courseware quality evaluation index system and accounts for the specifics and meaning of all kinds of indexes.

articleTitle: Research on reverse time migration imaging and Huffman coding
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Reverse Time Migration is a precise migration methods, however, RTM spends too long computer time which impedes its development. In the paper, the aim is to save the computer time based on analyzing the reason of it, and the Huffman coding is employed into RTM for saving the memory consumption which reduce the computer time. Marmousi model is used and the migration results illustrate that the method not only can solve the long computer time problem, but also acquire the comparative imaging accuracy.

articleTitle: A gossip-based TDOA distributed localization algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Distributed localization has been established as a key problem in wireless sensor networks and many localization algorithms have been proposed in this area. In this paper, a novel distributed TDOA passive localization method based on gossip algorithms is proposed, which can obviously improve the performance of the previous algorithms. According to our numerical results, adding the gossip mechanism into the TDOA localization frame not only significantly improves the positioning accuracy, but also contributes to the situation that all the beacon nodes acquire the same coordinates of the target sensor node which we call it reaches a distributed average consensus for all the beacon nodes. This is sometimes very useful for special applications such as military precision strike and illegal radio station positioning. We compared the newly designed localization algorithms with the classical Taylor-series estimation algorithm for TDOA localization, and the numerical results are also provided to prove the effectiveness and advantage of our novel algorithm.

articleTitle: Gamification interaction design of online education
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: One of the fastest growing use of technology is for online education which is a trend of contemporary education. And it is continually improving with constantly developing and revising its programs to suit today's students. This paper analyzes the existing problems of interaction design for online education, discusses a user-centered gamification interaction strategy, with the purpose of improving the utilization rate of online education resources and realizing the optimization of teaching effect and user experience. At last, it explores the future development of online education interaction.

articleTitle: Aggregate over multi-hop homomorphic encrypted data in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The importance of sensitive information carried and exchanges by wireless sensors in many applications helped develop a plethora of protocols and algorithms essentially to secure data for their aggregation in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), among which the the elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) with homomorphic properties allowing users to execute operations on encrypted metrics values. From the low battery that characterized sensors nodes and the scarce energy supplies in sensor networks, the numerous applications arising with the revolutionizing usage of wireless sensor node lead to a major conclusion, security or reliability and durability are mandatory when deploying any hardware device such as sensor nodes. In this paper, the Aggregate over Multi-Hop Homomorphic Encrypted Data (AMHED) scheme principal goal is to ensure that each sensor readings is aggregated within the WSN in a secure fashion, while fully preserving its privacy and integrity. The comparison is performed in this paper by analyzing the working principle of both ECC and RSA. Sensors readings (data) are neither forged nor compromised.

articleTitle: A novel day-ahead generation scheduling and spinning reserve determination model for power grid containing wind power
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A novel day-ahead generation scheduling and spinning reserve determination model was proposed for power grid with large-scale wind power. The load shedding losses and the wind curtailment losses were estimated by using the probability density function. And they are taken as two operation risk costs integrated into the generation cost objective function. While fully meeting the unit ramp rate constraints and the network security constraints, the day-ahead generation schedule of conventional units and the up/down spinning reserve capacities were solved simultaneously. The priority list method and the minimum marginal cost based economic dispatch algorithm are used to solve the proposed model. Numerical results of modified IEEE reliability test system show that the proposed model and method are effective.

articleTitle: Adaptive active defense mechanism in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Security in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is very important. Traditional security schemes abandon compromised nodes and add a lot of redundancies to make the network resilient. These methods are not applicable to resource-limited WSNs. This paper proposes an adaptive and active defense mechanism with low power consumption. In our scheme, some nodes are configured as monitoring nodes to identify attacks; after determining the attacker, the defense system is activated and actively rescue compromised nodes. Our scheme consumes battery wisely since only a small set of nodes are selected as monitoring nodes and defense nodes are adaptively chosen to counter the attack. We also enhance the adaptive active defense mechanism by adding the functionality which allows administrators to add or change rules of defense.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: integrated circuits; particle swarm optimization; wireless sensor networks; geotechnical engineering; dams; RFID; telecommunication security; image processing; discrete control systems; power system engineering; electronic commerce; aqueduct; opportunistic networks; Big Data; video signal processing; data handling; power system control; mobile robots; data security; speech recognition; cloud computing; and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Shunt-feedback transimpedance amplifier in 0.18μm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Low noise and low Power transimpedance amplifiers (TIA) are essential module for optical sensor based systems. But low power and low noise TIAs are still a challenge for the scientists despite of rapid advances in complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) technology. This paper proposes a three-stage nested miller compensated (NMC) based design of low noise low power transimpedance amplifier for stable wideband operation. The circuit is designed in the 0.18μm CMOS technology by using Mentor Graphics environment. The simulation results show that the proposed TIA can operate at frequency 20 KHz and produces an output of 1.4265V for ±1.2 V input voltages dissipating only 2.9206 mW power at 27°C temperature. The complete layout of the TIA is only 0.005 μm2. This shunt-feedback TIA can be a better choice for high-resolution, low-to mid frequency applications.

articleTitle: Study on Tibetan new meaning word extraction
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper proposes a model to automatically extract Tibetan new meaning words. Through building the dynamic Tibetan corpus from 2009 to 2012, which covers more than 16 Tibetan network media of Tibet, Qinghai, Sichuan, Gansu and Yunnan, we research on the key techniques of Tibetan new meaning word extraction: (1) construction of Tibetan new word electronic dictionary; (2) using word frequency ratio to find new meaning words; (3) using word co-occurrence techniques to extract and analysis Tibetan new meaning words.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of arc flexible hinge stress
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Flexible hinges have some characteristics, such as small volume, without rubs, ceaseless, good rigidity and high sensitivity. As the traditional hinge been replaced with the flexible hinge, the parallel mechanism just right have the above advantages, and suitable be used for micro-motion robot. Flexible hinges are widely used in micro robotic, and the internal stress of the flexible hinge within the allowable stress range is the guarantee of the normal work of the flexible hinge. In this paper, the internal stress under different factors of the arc flexure hinge is analyzed by using the finite element method, and the influence of the flexible hinge structure parameters to the internal stress is analyzed, which provide references for the selection of the flexible hinge in the practical application.

articleTitle: H-SRTF: A real-time framework supporting state machine model
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The state machine can be used to describe reactive event-driven software system effectively. Existing commercial tools which can generate code from the state diagram all base on real-time framework mostly. But the code size of these frameworks is a little more, it will be a big shortage for military weapon systems that the hardware resources are limited and time is critical. By the detailed analysis of mapping strategy from state diagram model to real-time framework, a smart real-time framework is designed and implemented by C language. The framework can adapt to two cases, i.e. operating system exists or not, and can adapt to two types of active objects, i.e. task and interruption.

articleTitle: Application of a flow type quartz crystal microbalance immunosensor for detection of cartilage oligomeric matrix protein and α1-antitrypsin
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic disease that often occurs in the elderly population. Currently, the most common methods for diagnosing OA are radiographs and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) method which are specific but require specialized laboratory facilities and highly trained personal. In this work, it developed a user friendly and non-invasive method that is quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) immunosensor, which the biointerface was designed to immobilize antibody by self-assembled monolayer (SAM) technique on the QCM surface. Cartilage oligomeric matrix protein (COMP) and α1-antitrypsin (AAT) were used as antibodies. The developed QCM-based immunosensor for COMP and AAT detection showed good sensitivity, linearity (99.9%), specificity and reliability.

articleTitle: GM (1,1) model application in power load forecasting based on moving average method
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Grey prediction has advantages of need less historical data, foperating speed is fast, algorithm is simple, easy to test, so it is suitable for use in power load forecasting. But grey model has some limitations, the data dispersion degree is more bigger, the gray is also more bigger, it will reduce the accuracy of prediction. This paper adopts the moving average method to improve the raw data, so as to increase the data weights, while avoiding predicted value excessive volatility, So it can improve the load forecast accuracy.

articleTitle: The application and research on RSS technology in library individual information service
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Introduction of advanced technologies into library could improve the level of library service. RSS technology could disseminate and aggregate information easily with the characters of instantaneity, operability, interactivity and personality. In this paper we discuss the features of RSS as well as the present state of library service, and then we focus on the usages of RSS technology in library to upgrade the standard of individual information service in six specific aspects.

articleTitle: Open WSN indoor localization platform design
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The fast development of WSN (Wireless Sensor Network) provide the solution to indoor localization application. To which, the position accuracy become the essential problem need to solve. At the same time the cost of software development also impede the indoor application. This paper introduces in detail the composition of the whole system and the design of localization algorithm based on RSSI. Through computing the relevance of adjacent nodes of target tag, the enhanced localization method is introduced and designing a LBS platform based on FOSS middle ware in a new way prove the possibility to build a high accuracy indoor localization system based on WSN at low cost.

articleTitle: PID control for throttle actuator of engine in unattended pumping station
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In order to precise control diesel engine throttle of pumping station, the mathematical model of the control system with DC stepper motor as actuator was established, and the fuzzy adaptive PID control strategy was selected. The control strategy for DC stepper motor was optimized to adjust throttle opening by motor angle. The response time was changed from 0.42s to 0.16s through the simulation analysis in Matlab. The results show that the dynamic response of the control scheme is fast, and its applicability is well.

articleTitle: Accurate loop-delay estimation method in digital predistortion system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Digital predistortion is an effective method to compensate for nonlinear distortion of power amplifier. In order to improve the linearization performance of digital predistortion, an accurate loop-delay estimation method is proposed. This method can overcome the impairment caused by the nonlinear distortion of power amplifier, and it has higher accuracy and lower computation complexity than the previous loop-delay estimation methods. Simulation results show the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on the prevent cable twisting control strategy of wind turbine yaw control system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, different effects on the efficiency of wind power generation between automatic alignment of the wind turbine and cable twisting then untwisting, has been studied. Then the prevent cable twisting control strategy of wind turbine yaw system is proposed to reduce probability of occurrence of cable twisting, thus it helps to improve the generating capacity of wind power generation. Finally, the configuration software MCGS used to create the simulation model of wind turbine's yaw control systems and implement the relevant module control method. MCGS simulations prove the validity of proposed prevent cable twisting control strategy.

articleTitle: On applications of short distance RF for smart grid at distribution level
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Power distribution system is one of the important parts of smart grid. Due to its large scale, only a small part in power distribution system employs optical fiber infrastructure. In this paper, we propose an architecture of hybrid short distance RF and wide band communication. We analyze why these two technologies complementary well in power distribution level. We summarized three short distance RF network models according to different traffic mode. Then we discuss four essential issues when applying short distance RF regard our experience. Finally, we illustrate three successful use cases in China mainland. We believe that short distance RF can play an effective role only in the condition of binding with the application scenarios tightly.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation for a recursive least square algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A recursive least square algorithm is implemented in this paper. Memory Nonlinearity of digital receiver is compensated by using a blind identification algorithm based on nonlinear model. A least-squared blind identification criterion to minimize all the energy of the nonlinearity in the receiver's output signal is implemented under circumstances of not knowing the information of the receiver's input signal. The orders and memory depths of the Volterra model are tested and updated automatically. A double-precision arbitrary-dimensional matrix inversion module is implemented in the requirement of the least-squared method. The digital post calibration processes in real-time. Experimental results on the actual nonlinear circuit illustrate the validity of the implemented technique.

articleTitle: Emotional classification based on the tempo and mutation degrees
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The article put forward a model for music emotion classification research. The main research contents are extracting the tempo from the MIDI file and defining the rhythm mutation degree. Let the two factors as the input of the music emotion model, we simulated the model in matlab. We used the improved support vector machine (SVM) classification algorithm to classify the emotion. In order to achieve the precise classification, we trained the SVM by a variety of samples.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s orthogonally concatenated BCH encoder for fiber communications
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a 10Gb/s concatenated BCH encoder of super FEC. The concatenated BCH encoder module contains 32 BCH column encoder groups and 2 BCH row encoder groups. To achieve high speed, parallel encoding technique is employed. In addition, some optimization methods such as sub-expression sharing and tree-based structure are also adopted to balance the gates' fanout and reduce the delay. The concatenated BCH encoder has been designed and realized in the FPGA. The simulation results show that the data rate of 10Gb/s can be realized under the working frequency of 156Hz.

articleTitle: The electrical fault diagnosis of early induction motor based on wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: At present, non-stationary signals can be often found in the fault signal of the motor, when conducting the diagnosis and analysis of common fault for various types of asynchronous electrical equipment that is widely used in various fields. It will produce a higher rate of misjudgment if we use the Fourier analysis which is a traditional method. Therefore, we will introduce the wavelet transform to the early failure detection of induction motor for its excellent time-frequency localization properties, and we validate the good effect of this method through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: An noval biometric-based remote user authentication scheme for C/S system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The authors first review the recently proposed Das's biometric-based remote user authentication scheme, and then show that Das's scheme still has some design flaws. In order to withstand the flaws in his scheme, an improvement of his scheme is further proposed. Cryptanalysis shows that our scheme is more efficient and can provide strong authentication by using verifying biometric, password as well as random nonces generated by the user and server.

articleTitle: Ship simulation manipulation skills assessment based on a fuzzy comprehensive model
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The complex environment maritime police ship at sea duty law enforcement faced manipulation skills of the crew put forward higher requirements. Evaluation of manual evaluation method is one of law enforcement vessels manipulation skills commonly used methods, the results have certain subjectivity and arbitrariness. This paper attempts to establish a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model evaluation index. The use of computer-aided technology preparation software, through a narrow channel simulation case study Captain comprehensive evaluation skills to manipulate the situation. Compared with the artificial evaluation, the error is small, the results more objective.

articleTitle: Electric power information system security risk assessment based on fuzzy rating multilevel analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Based on large-scale information system, the system model of active defense system, the information system risk identification and analysis of the deficiencies and shortcomings, this paper describes a multi-level analysis based on fuzzy evaluation model of the risk. By analyzing the characteristics of the information system to analysis the risk and risk factor in the information system, this paper adopts the Multi-level analysis technology and fuzzy evaluation method to establish the risk assessment of risk and calculation model.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristic analysis of fuyang river aqueduct
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Dynamic characteristic analysis of aqueduct structure is the foundation of the seismic response analysis and seismic design, includes the calculation and analysis of natural vibration frequency and main vibration mode. The natural vibration frequency not only is the index of aqueduct structure rigidity, but also is the basis of identifying whether the aqueduct structure resonance occur. This paper mainly adopts the finite element analysis software ANSYS to calculate and analyze the dynamic characteristic of aqueduct structure, using added mass method to deal with interaction between water and aqueduct wall, and get the natural vibration frequency and main vibration mode of the rectangular aqueduct in different water depth, the research results provide the basis for the seismic design and protection of aqueduct.

articleTitle: A two-dimensional direction finding estimation with L-shape uniform linear arrays
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In order to decrease two-dimensional DOA computational complexity, a 2-D direction finding method is proposed with L-shape uniform linear arrays when the additive white Gaussian noises exist. A cross-correlation matrix of received signals is first constructed. Afterwards, signal subspace can be acquired by performing eigen-value decomposition of the matrix. The signal subspace is divided into two sub-arrays. Then, a new matrix is reconstructed with the two sub-arrays is mentioned above and eigen-value decomposition theory is applied to it. This approach enables 2D direction-of-arrival (DOA) and needs low computation. In the proposed method, parameters can match automatically without spectral peak searching. Simulation results demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and implement a typing game for commonly used Tibetan words based on the Macromedia Flash
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: As the development of information technology in Tibetan, Tibetan language has been widely used. In this paper, a Tibetan vocabulary typing game based on a commonly used Flash action script language is designed to achieve the vocabulary display, drop, input, count and result output function. It is a simple learning tool for Tibetan language learners.

articleTitle: A ROI encryption scheme for H.264 video based on moving object detection
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To protect the privacy in the surveillance video, a selective encryption scheme for region of interest (ROI) of H.264 video is proposed in this paper. By only encrypting the content of ROIs, the most important part of video can be protected with less cost and operation. The technique of moving object detection is employed to locate the ROIs in the video automatically. There is no need to transmit additional position information of ROIs to the end of decryption. ROI is encrypted with other area unchanged under the mechanism of Flexible Macroblock Ordering (FMO). A new encryption algorithm is designed to modify both luminance component and chrominance components to achieve good encryption quality and location accuracy. In decryption, the encrypted area is located automatically, and the encrypted video is decrypted with the secret key. JM 18.4 software is employed to perform the simulation experiment. Experimental results present the accuracy and effectiveness of our scheme to encrypt and decrypt the ROIs in H.264 video.

articleTitle: Application research in Internet information retrieval of data mining technology
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: According to the problem of the constant increase of internet data and the current Internet information retrieval system has been unable to meet the needs of data and information retrieval, this paper puts forward the data mining based Internet information retrieval system. The paper first uses data mining to excavate association rules, and evaluates the entire behavior simulation of users resources need according to a certain factor of user's retrieval resources, and then uses bayesian network algorithm to correlate the mining data. Experimental simulation results show that the application of bayesian network algorithm into Internet information retrieval has implemented intelligence and personalization of information retrieval to a certain extent, which has certain research value.

articleTitle: Density-accumulated arbitrary shaped clustering for large data sets
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To improve the efficiency of finding arbitrary shape clusters from large data sets and overcome the adverse effect on the clustering accuracy from noise data, an arbitrary shaped clustering algorithm based on density-accumulated is proposed. Using the idea of particle coagulation, the algorithm firstly generates a small scale subset only by one scanning large original data set, in which each of data points is given a weight value. Second, noise data are removed from the weighted subset in terms of the weight distribution of data points so that the clear structures and shapes of clusters are obtained. Finally, the arbitrary shape clusters are found from the weighted subset using the existing clustering algorithms such as a hierarchical, a density-based or a spectral clustering algorithm, and then the cluster structures of original data set are represented by those of the weighted subset. The experimental results show that the novel method has high clustering efficiency and accuracy, and can effectively suppress noise in data set.

articleTitle: No-reference video quality assessment based on temporal information extraction
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a no-reference objective video quality assessment method for compressed video. Only employed two parameters are involved: the change of the bit rate for the encoded video and the difference between its successive frames, and assessed the video quality by analyzing the average change of the difference between its successive frames with the bit rate variety of the encoded video. The parameters are easily obtained through extraction. This paper provides a theoretical analysis for the proposed method, which is well suited to video quality assessment when quality degradation is from lossy compression or induced by the channel.

articleTitle: Interest-based prediction routing protocol in socially-aware opportunistic networks
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: People in life rely more and more on portable mobile devices. Many applications and services through wireless technologies are provided. Most of mobile devices are carried by people. Thus, the mobility of mobile devices is influenced heavily by people's social relationship. Socially-aware Opportunistic Networks are used in intermittently connected networks by use of store-carry-and-forward fashion. It is mainly based on social relationship to design solutions for problem such as routing protocol. In this paper, we study social relationship about interest information among people and use them to predict the contact probability. We present Interest-based Prediction routing protocol (InP) and establish experiments based on real trace data set from SIGCOMM2009. The simulation results show that the efficiency of InP outperforms Epidemic and PROPHET in higher delivery ratio, lower overhead and shorter average latency.

articleTitle: Iterative decoding of orthogonally concatenated code for fiber communications
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a 10Gb/s concatenated BCH iterative decoder of super FEC. This iterative decoder consists of 3 row decoding modules and 2 column decoding modules which are cascaded together. Parallel decoding strategy is employed in the row decoder which reduces the total decoding latency from 1928 cycles to 578 cycles. Taking advantage of RAM blocks, the implementation of column decoding becomes easier compared to original structure. Other techniques like multiplexing and pipeline technology are adopted to improve the path delay and resource consumption. A 10Gb/s implementation is realized on FPGA device under the working frequency of 156.25 MHz.

articleTitle: Dispersion as stopping criterion for Vortex particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a stopping criterion for the optimization algorithm based on particle swarms with vorticity features: Vortex Particle Swarm Optimization (VPSO). The optimization algorithm employs translational movements for convergence and dispersion behavior to enhance exploration. These behaviors are induced by choosing the swarm parameters to change between translational (convergence) and circular movements (dispersion). Since exploration is given by the dispersion process, it is important to have a stop criterion based on swarm dispersion. The algorithm and the stopping criterion are shown using a test function in two dimensions.

articleTitle: Design of vehicle detection system based on ZigBee and AMR
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more vehicles make traffic heavier day by day, and parking spaces are becoming lack. It leads to parking difficult and disorder. A modernized intelligent parking system (IPS) is designed to help solve these problems. This system is based on ZigBee and Anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) technologies. ZigBee is a low-power, low-cost, wireless mesh network standard. ZigBee sensor included in the parking detector of the system is used to transmit processed data connected by AMR sensor. AMR sensor is applied to detect the disturbed earth's magnetic field intensity when a vehicle is parking in the space. The experiments of IPS working are done, and the results show that the detected disturbance information after processed can illustrate accurately the state of the parking space, free or not.

articleTitle: The optimization research of electric car batteries on distribution network
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This article mainly aims at the secondary distribution of the electric car battery. The starting point is to coverage in power plant on every side, and to avoid overlapping distribution area and the unreasonable distribution radius is not reasonable. It establishes the minimum cost model of distribution center. And in order to satisfy the demands of battery the best distribution, it uses a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation which considered the effects of internal and external factors to optimize distribution network. Numerical example shows the correctness and validity of the method.

articleTitle: A study of background cleaning and data allocation for multi-channel SSDs
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Due to the idiosyncrasies of NAND flash memories, such as erase-before-write and bulk erase, SSDs employ an internal garbage collection process to recycle obsolete data to provide free spaces. To overlap the cleaning with I/O services in parallel units of multi-channel SSDs, a finer-granularity cleaning has been proposed, namely background cleaning. This method is not widely accepted for its reliability and wear-leveling problems. In this work, we study the background cleaning with different striping allocation policies, analyzing the SSD performance and write amplification with diverse cleaning units. Trace-driven simulations reveal that with certain striping allocation policies, finer-granularity cleaning can improve the SSD performance, as well as keep comparable cleaning efficiency, even without using the copy-back command.

articleTitle: A novel self-regulatory failure detection algorithm for distributed storage system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Distributed storage systems have the advantages of self-organizing, scalability, robust and fault-tolerant, which provide fundamental support for mission-critical applications. Unfortunately, there still exist some problems in real network conditions, especially, when considering asynchronous distributed environments, where messages may be delayed indefinitely and nodes may fail. So, failure detector is one of basic components to build a reliable distributed storage system. Considering the highly dynamic characteristics of distributed system, a novel self-regulatory failure detection algorithm (SFDA), which can combine heartbeat strategy with unbiased grey prediction model, is designed to improve the failure detection quality of system (QoS) according to the application needs and network environment changes. The key goal of using correction value in SFDA is to provide adoptable and usable service in all kinds of applications. The results show that, failure detector based on SFDA is more effective and flexible than other failure detectors.

articleTitle: Force analysis of special-shaped column frame shear wall structure under earthquake
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper adopts the universal finite element calculating software to analyse the special-shaped column frame shear wall structure, Deducing variation law of the structure's stress and displacement under earthquake. These provide some references of design and construction for the special-shaped column frame shear wall structure.

articleTitle: Relationship between web search data and the sales of German car in China
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In recent years, auto market of China has achieved a great development, and it's a hot topic to study the sales of German car in China. This paper used a new data resource - queries from search engine, to study the relationship between web search data and the sales of German cars in China, built conceptual framework, selected keywords, composed the keywords into composite index, found a strong correlation, and finally a result of prediction sales was given in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Design on virtual simulation verification platform of airdrop adaptability of airborne equipment
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Aim at the problem that airborne equipment lacks quantitative analysis of airdrop adaptability, this paper put forward to build a virtual simulation verification platform of airdrop adaptability, integrated software and hardware, which uses technology of numerical calculation, modeling and simulation and virtual test. The airdrop process of airborne equipment which includes loading, air transportation, deplaning, descent and landing can be calculated and simulated, and airdrop adaptability of airborne equipment can be quantitatively analyzed, providing support of theories and simulated experiments to development, improvement, battle usage in airborne equipment.

articleTitle: Research of the discrete sliding mode variable structure algorithm based on the exponential trending rule
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Instability characteristics of a shipborne satellite communication station tend to reduce the tracking accuracy and communication quality. To improve the system performance, an antenna servo controller based on DSP is developed in this paper. For the servo system, a new algorithm based on the exponential trending rule discrete sliding mode variable structure algorithm is proposed. The theoretical analysis is derived and experimental simulating are developed. Experiment results show that a discrete controller and its control algorithm satisfies the stability. Compared with the traditional PID law, the novel algorithm has much better performance on real-time adjustment. The sensitivity of the servo system to the continuous or unexpected interferences are greatly reduced and robustness are obviously strengthened.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of TFT in EPS system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a method of TFT storage and matching based on EPS bearer. The PF filter were stored in the bearer information unit according to the corresponding bearer identification t. At the same time in order to realize the IP packet data matching based on PF priority, we establish the PF information table in accordance with the priority of PF. Using PF information table can quickly locate the PF storage location and complete the IP packet matching. The PF storage according to the bearer identification and PF ID, TFT storage and modified completed in the corresponding bearer, avoid amount of work of sequential query, save the PF maintenance overhead.

articleTitle: The attack on DDIMT: Dynamic data and indirect mutual trust for cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Cloud computing offers a kind of on-demand computing method that lets users use IT resources such as network, operating system, hardware, software, application and so on when needing them. However, cloud computing faces many security issues including data integrity, data confidentiality and access control. Recently, Barsoum et al. presents a cloud-based data access scheme that allows the data owner to benefit from the facilities offered by the CSP and enables indirect mutual trust between them. They declare that their scheme can assure data integrity, newness and CSP's defense. However, through our security analysis, their scheme still has some security vulnerabilities. It will easily suffer from the integrity attack, newness attack and CSP's defense attack. In other words, Although CSP have corrupted the outsourced data or ignore the data-updated request issued by the owner, the CSP is able to cheat authorized user into passing through the integrity checking, On the contrary, the owner also accuses CSP of having corrupted the outsourced data, whereas in reality the CSP not.

articleTitle: Scraps of paper restoration design fuzzy pattern recognition and matching based on strokes
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The essay talks about using the fuzzy model recognition and strokes matched ways in splicing in regular fragment papers which is made by shredder, and checking its correctness by strokes matched ways. Realize this splicing work by using MATLAB. The results show that the scraps of paper in the case of only crosscutting (longitudinal cut), may recover fully stitching and intelligent high; In the case of both cross cut and longitudinal cut can realize most of the recovery with high intelligence. Provide strong support for the important documents after damage repair.

articleTitle: Research on equipment maintenance support process simulation basing on timed Petri net
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Basing on analysising the importance of maintenance support process modeling and simulating, we have analysised the application characteristics of Petri model used in the process simulation. Then, aiming to some equipment system maintenance support process, we established the corresponding TTPN model. At last, by simulation we analysised indexes such as the ratio of resource using and the ratio of task success at different maintenance support resource configuration, which offers decision support to the optimizing configuration of maintenance support resources. The results of simulations prove the practicability and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Study on finite element analysis of mortar brick rectangular-sectioned aqueduct
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Aqueduct is a important water conveyance buildings, this paper adopts finite element method to carry out three-dimensional finite element simulation analysis for Shangkeng mortar brick rectangular-sectioned aqueduct. Researching variation law of the aqueduct's stress and displacement in construction process and operating process. Analysis results show that, structure of Shangkeng mortar brick rectangular-sectioned aqueduct is reasonable, force of aqueduct structure is explicit, it meets the requirements for engineering.

articleTitle: The affect factors to the modification of WTG's power curve
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: WTG's power curve is the effectively measure of the economic and technical level of a WTG[1]. The modification methods of WTGs power curve are discussed in the paper. And the affect factors to the power curve are also talked over such as air density, air temperature and so on. So the methods of the power curve modification and actual effect factors determine the practicality of the final power curve.

articleTitle: Research and realization of RLC layer unacknowledged mode in LTE system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In order to satisfy the rate of LTE system data transmission, according to the latest release of 3GPP standards, we analyze unacknowledged mode transfer of RLC layer, And provides the specific method of UM data transmission in terminal Tester developed, Through the test of protocol conformance by co-simulation of SDL and TTCN, we can see this method can perform UM related functions well and has a practical value.

articleTitle: A rapid calculation for current distribution of modeling antennas on conductive grounds
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Current distribution An image method combined with the image theory and the moment of method is proposed by using the modified reflecting coefficients of surface impedance, to analyze the input impedance of the antennas on different grounds media. The calculated data is compared with the measured data. After analysis and simulation, conclusion is drew that the radiation efficiency of the vertical wire antennas at high frequency may be changed obviously by different grounds under them. And it is also concluded that input impedance of the antenna which is built on metal screen on an imperfect ground is varied with the frequency changing and the causes are analyzed. The proposed rapid calculation method can give an alternative to the conventional one.

articleTitle: Influence of phasor measurement unit in power system dynamic state estimation
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Monitoring and control of the power system have become very important functions, for achieving a high reliability in the system and improving the Energy Management System (EMS) functions. Recently, Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) has become one of the EMS applications for real time monitoring at the control center. In this paper, Phasor Measurement Unit based Dynamic State Estimation(DSE) is proposed under normal operating and bad data conditions, by using the decoupled current measurement as a new method for including PMU in DSE. The proposed method is carried out using the standard data IEEE 14-bus system as a case study.

articleTitle: Distributed lightning current monitoring and its application to lightning protection on transmission line
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To correctly record the process of lightning strike on power line and locate the fault site fast, serving to summarize their features and further take targeted protection measures against lightning strike, a distributed lightning current monitoring technology is proposed based on the simulation result. It's able to obtain necessary parameters of transient current, therefore make recognition of lightning fault and distinction of strike type, thus maximizing the effectiveness of protection measures. Preliminary trial operation suggests it works.

articleTitle: Study of the robotic manipulators' kinematic manipulability
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The series robotic manipulator's operation space is studied, the conclusion that the greater of the robotic manipulator's operation space volume, the better of the robotic manipulator's manipulability is drawn, volume element based on redundant robotic manipulator's kinematics is proposed as an operational performance index. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>-DOF serial robotic manipulator's operation space is <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>-dimensional Riemannian manifold, the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>-dimensional Riemannian manifold volume is calculated using the moving coordinate system and the exterior product definition in differential geometry, and get the robotic manipulator's operation space volume, and compared the obtained results with the operation space volume using inner product determinant in the literature, it shows that the volume element as a kinematic operational performance index is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on the method of concurrency control in collaborative design base on Tentative Hold protocol
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To solve the problem that collaborative design concurrency control cannot adopt optimistic locking mechanism or traditional pessimistic locking mode, THP(Tentative Hold Protocol) is introduced into collaborative design concurrency control method on the basis of studying on it and its transaction model. And then, a conflict prevention method is proposed based on THP. The method avoids deadlock and ensures operational priority for customers with higher privilege through object resource request, resource book, operation broadcast and real-time perception. Finally, closed single-stage worm drive is set as an example to illustrate the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Stress calculation of unlined pressure tunnel surrounding rock in hydraulic engineering
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In hydraulic engineering, the running state of pressure diversion tunnel directly affects the normal use and economic benefit of the whole project. This paper bases on the deep-lying circular tunnel and analyse stress distribution in the unlined hydraulic tunnel surrounding rock by using the finite element method, respectively study the stress after the completion of the tunnel excavation, additional stress produced by the internal water pressure, stress distribution produced during water filling operation. These research results provide some references of design and construction for unlined pressure tunnel.

articleTitle: Downlink performance of cooperative distributed antenna systems over Nakagami-m fading channels in multi-cell environment
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the downlink performance of cooperative distributed antenna systems (DAS) in multi-cell environment, including ergodic capacity, outage probability, and bit error rate (BER). Blanket transmission, all distributed antenna modules (DAMs) in one cell are utilized to transmit signals, is considered and can be seemed as virtual multiple-input single-output (V-MISO) system. The interference plus noise is considered as Gaussian noise with fixed variance by central limit theorem (CLT), while the channels are assumed to suffer from independent and identical Nakagami-m fading together with propagation path loss. From the perspective of information theory, the closed-form expressions for ergodic capacity and BER are derived via iterative method, while for outage probability, it is given through algebraic operations. Finally extensive simulations are performed to validate our theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Dynamic error compensation of POS in power transmission line inspection
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The inspection of power transmission line is very important to ensure the safety of our daily life, and the use of remote sensing system in power transmission line inspection is a new research area in these years. Position and orientation measurement System (POS) is a kind of equipment that is used to provide accurate attitude and position information of the remote sensing system. The dynamic error of POS is closely related to the structure of its application target. In order to improve the accuracy of POS, in this paper, we mainly discuss the dynamic error compensation of POS that is used in remote sensing system. The structure of the remote sensing system is introduced firstly, and the dynamic error analysis is presented according to the structure of the system, then experimental study is carried out on a real remote sensing system in ground to validate the effectiveness of the new dynamic error compensation method. The experiment results show that, the new method can compensate the dynamic error of POS effectively.

articleTitle: The study of surface roughness on the hydrostatic pads of heavy rotary table
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This study theoretically analyzes the effect of surface roughness on the pressure distribution and load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads. The average pressure was expressed by establishing the volume flow rate of per unit width. In this study, we established two average Reynolds equations on radial direction and circumferential direction with the consideration of one-dimensional roughness. On the basis of the one-dimensional modified Reynolds equation, this study analyzes the pressure distribution and load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads by solving the Reynolds equation using the finite difference method. According to the results, the effect of circumferential roughness provides an increase in load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads as compared to the smooth-bearing case. While the load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads decreased for the radial roughness case. Therefore, we can draw the conclusion that considering circumferential roughness can increase the load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads in some specific cases. On the basis of considering the roughness, the load-carrying capacity of hydrostatic circular pads should be drastically reduced with the increase of roughness parameters whether considering the radial or circumferential roughness.

articleTitle: Tests on causal relationships between CO2 emissions and economic growth in China based on VECM model
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A vector error correction model (VECM) model was developed based on data from 1990 to 2010 to inspect the short and long run causal relationships between CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions and economic growth in China. The causal relation results show that CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions does not affect economic growth in the short or long run, but that economic growth excites CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions in the short run. The results show that low-carbon industries will not impede economic growth in the long run, and the government of China should encourage the development of low-carbon industries.

articleTitle: The virtual disassembly research based on geometrical and physical constraints
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The traditional virtual disassembly technology is difficult to fully complete virtual disassembly. This paper proposes the method, which is based on the geometrical and physical constraints. It introduces a common combination of physical constraints, dismantling the structure of a tree, and proposes a solution method based on the geometrical and physical constraints, finally it simulates and verifies the method. This method makes full use of the geometric constraints and physical constraints of the parts to be disassembled solve; constantly the corresponding degrees of movement freedom and movement vice, obtains the transformation matrix of disassembly through the freedom, achieved the precise positioning of parts.

articleTitle: Prediction of fast fading channel using support vector
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Due to channel exists strange attractors, the paper proposed SV predictive model of multi-path fading channel based on the origin of support vector (SV) concept. According to the chaotic reconstructing theory of phase space delay, the chaotic fading channel model was established. The training set is used to be support object elements. Machine self-learning makes error least upper bound of generalization model to be minimum. The non-linear higher dimension map was realized by the least squares support vector domain. The result indicates that the support vector domain needs little support vector with fast convergence rate. The system has robustness characteristic and kernel function of flexible choice.

articleTitle: Local search for dynamic vehicle routing problem with time windows
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Vehicle Routing Problems have been extensively analyzed to reduce transportation costs. More particularly, the Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (DVRPTW) imposes the period of time of customer availability and the request time of customer as two constraints, which precisely reflects the real world situations. Using minimization of the total distance as the main objective to be fulfilled, this paper proposes a general framework to deal with DVRPTW. Based on this framework, different local search heuristics are also designed to wisely adjust the convergence speed. Extensive experiments are conducted. And the results prove the effectiveness and the efficiency of our approach.

articleTitle: Research on finite element analysis for reinforced concrete slab dam of Shuangjiangkou reservoir
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Through analyzing reinforced concrete slab dam structure's mechanical characteristics in construction process and operating process, this paper adopts finite element method to carry out simulation analysis for reinforced concrete slab dam of Shuangjiangkou reservoir. Deducing distribution laws of the dam's stress and displacement in construction process and operating process. Analysis results show that, reinforced concrete slab dam of Shuangjiangkou reservoir construction is reasonable, force analysis is clear, it meets the requirements for design.

articleTitle: The intelligent control of ITO bar's resistance for touch panel
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The paper presents an intelligent control mechanism for the ITO bar's resistance of touch panel (TP). The artificial neural network is used to catch the complex relationship between bar's resistance and its relevant manufacturing parameters during the printing and etching processes. An effective and accurate manufacturing mechanism of ITO bar is expected to be developed. This mechanism can be taken as a tool which is able to help the engineer to precisely control the manufacturing process of ITO bar such that the ideal touch panel with desired film thickness and resistance can be produced. Not only the rate of excellent product could be greatly improved, but also the business cost could be effectively saved.

articleTitle: Security assessment method for power grid planning under high penetration of variable generation
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The affiliation of stability and security is discussed. It is point out that the static security restrains, transient stability restrains and whole process security assessment should be deal with under different procedures in power grid planning. The procedure of security assessment for power grid planning under high penetration of variable generation is presented. It is point out that a part of the courses of the cascading events is with the features of the open complex giant system and that part should be simplified for it can't be simulated exactly. Another part of the courses is with strong cause and effect relationship between the front and back events and it can be simulated by improved simulation softwares. The overall process risk assessment method taking into account the pre-fault states of the generation system is presented. By the method, the costs of stabilizing facilities and the power cut losses will be counted in the composite annual costs for comparing and choosing the planning schemes.

articleTitle: Virtual maintenance environment layout planning research based on GA
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Virtual maintenance environment is the workplace of virtual repair disassembly and assembly and an important part of maintenance virtual realization. During the maintenance disassembly process it is easy to come to the condition that disassembled parts are complex and the disassembled parts are too many. In order to achieve good display results, resolve virtual maintenance disassembly parts and components layout problems in the 3-dimensions (3D) environment, the paper classifies the components according to the application of hierarchical division. As a result, 3D spatial distribution is simplified to multiple 2-dimensional (2D) layouts, to reduce the complexity of the layout. In the 2D layout, genetic algorithm is used to optimize for improving the quality of layout. Finally this paper applies the method to Aero-Engine high pressure compressor virtual disassembly parts and components layout, indicating that it is feasible.

articleTitle: Study on index system of risk assessment for centrifugal compressor on AHP
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: As the most important equipment in compressor station, the performance of centrifugal compressor unit is highly concerned with safety production and economic benefits of gas-transmission enterprise. In order to ensure well operating condition of centrifugal compressor unit, we should firstly make clear the design principle of index system of risk assessment, and establish the reliability block diagram (RBD). Then, based on above mechanism, the main trouble factors of centrifugal compressor unit can be obtained through the analysis and screening of experts. In this work, the structure of index system of risk assessment was built and the weight of assessment index was calculated for key equipments of compressor station. Finally, a suitable index system of risk assessment was established which can provide a reference for next quantitative risk assessment.

articleTitle: Research of target segmentation technology based on depth information
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: For segmentation algorithm widespread over-segmentation problem, design a combination of depth information and color information approach. Firstly, the image depth information combined statistical area in which the fill color on the basis of information obtained initial segmentation results, then combine Graph Cuts algorithm to over-segmentation part, and finally get the exact target. Through a variety of algorithms can be combined advanced segmentation results. Simulation results show that the new algorithm can effectively inhibit the design over-segmentation and under-segmentation, more precise target.

articleTitle: An extended S-polynomial for computing Gröbner bases
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Gröbner bases algorithm is an important symbolic method for solving polynomial equations, and S-polynomial is the crucial notion of Buchberger's algorithm. In order to improve the efficiency of Buchberger's algorithm, many researchers focused on polynomial reduction. Unlike the past approach, extended S-polynomial is introduced in this paper. It is obvious that S-polynomial is a special case of extended S-polynomial and it can derive out Gröbner bases also. However, compared with S-polynomial, it is distinctive that some polynomials with more lower degrees may be produced by extended S-polynomial ahead, this is very helpful to enhance the efficiency of the next polynomial reductions.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective optimization based on adaptive environmental selection
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: There are many defects for PSO to solve multi-objective optimization problems. For example, the population of particles will lose activity when algorithm falls into local optimum, and there is no good method to solve the problem of the select of the global optimal value for the population and the history of individual optimal value. This paper introduces SPEA2 environmental selection and pair selection strategy to algorithm to solve the problem of the select of the global optimal value for the population and the history of individual optimal value, and in order to solve the active of population particles problem this paper will use the adaptive principle to change the method of calculating speed weight. This paper will through the simulation experiment of four classical test functions and the planning of robot path to verify the performance of the algorithm what is changed.

articleTitle: The research of information exchange platform for intelligent power distribution and utilization based-on middleware technology
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents an information exchange platform to meet the communication requirements of modern intelligent power distribution and utilization management system. We present the main components, operating principles and application effects of our exchange platform. This platform provides management, configuration, exchanging, monitoring service for communication and running requirements, and designs an agent middleware which communicates and integrates with other systems. Finally, we show how to improve our information exchange platform.

articleTitle: Internetwork coal industry control network and IP networks to exchange research
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, the status of research comparative information standards at home and abroad on the basis of the analysis of the current mine information standards problem. In order to effectively improve the efficiency of coal mine of information technology and normative, eliminate information silos, improve the degree of data sharing, application system to achieve interconnection of information through the construction of the coal industry and coal industry standard system control network and the IP network to achieve data exchange standards this goal. The application of data exchange standards to unify the content and format of coal mine safety monitoring system data exchange management departments at all levels in order to achieve mine data sharing and data exchange. Therefore, building the coal industry, information technology standards, under the guidance of the standard system of research needed to develop mines data exchange standards is necessary.

articleTitle: Analysis of heterodyne detection system based on the subcarrier modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: On off key (OOK) is the main optical wireless communication modulation mode, but the scintillation noise caused by atmosphere turbulence had a strong impact on OOK optical communication system and it is hard to remove. Setting subcarrier modulating mode at transmitter, and Optical heterodyne detection communication system at receiver, this paper analyzes the relationship between error rate and Signal-to-Noise while using ASK subcarrier modulating method at transmitter.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal activity interactions detection in video survalliance
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, a novel framework to explore the activity spatial-temporal interactions in complex video surveillance scenes is proposed. Firstly, low-level motion features are detected and quantized into words. The Hierarchical Dirichlet Processes model is then applied to automatically cluster low-level features into atomic activities. Afterwards, the dynamic behaviors of the activities are represented as a multivariate point-process. The pair-wise causal scores and periods between activities are explicitly captured by the non-parametric Granger causality analysis, from which the activity spatial-temporal interactions are discovered. The results of the real world traffic datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling of grid connecting photovoltaic generation system with improved MPPT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
