abstract: In this paper, photovoltaic maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm based on duty cycle disturbing method is improved with a modified self-adopting step value calculation algorithm, the convergence of this modified tracking algorithm is speeded up compared with the original one and in the same time, numeric oscillation in the calculation process is avoided and the stability of convergence of algorithm is enhanced. A grid connecting photovoltaic generation system model has been developed with matlab/simulink, to fit for the using in power system phasor analysis, the converter is modeled in a reduced way in this system ensures that no power transferring variation will be led to. The MPPT algorithm is implemented with Matlab Simulink S 2 function and this will accelerate the calculating speed of simulation. To test the usability of modeled PV generation system in power system slow dynamic analysis, a simple power grid connected with PV system is constructed and simulation results show the effectiveness of this model.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis for reinforced concrete face rockfill dam of Tuanjie reservoir
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Through analyzing reinforced concrete face rockfill dam structure's mechanical characteristics in construction process and operating process, this paper adopts finite element method to carry out structural analysis for reinforced concrete face rockfill dam of Tuanjie reservoir. Deducing distribution law of the dam's stress and displacement in construction process and operating process. Analysis results show that, reinforced concrete face rockfill dam of Tuanjie reservoir is reasonable, it meets the requirements for design.

articleTitle: Structure design and analysis of reinforced concrete inverted siphon
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Inverted siphon structure is a common water conveyance buildings, this paper adopts finite element calculation software to carry out three-dimensional finite element simulation analysis for Zhangcun tunnel type inverted siphon structure, computer is used fully as efficient computational tools. Deducing variation law of the inverted siphon's stress and displacement in construction process and operating process. Analysis results further verified that design scheme is reasonable and safe, it has certain reference value. Zhangcun tunnel type inverted siphon structure is safety, it meets the requirements for engineering.

articleTitle: Parameters adjustment for VOD endpoint carbon content and endpoint temperature prediction model
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In Vacuum Oxygen Decarburization(VOD) steel refining process, the endpoint carbon content and endpoint temperature are criteria for smelting products. A VOD model is often needed to predict the endpoint data. During the modeling of VOD, some parameters are difficult to chose, thus affects the model prediction accuracy. Based on the VOD mathematical model, the process is analyzed to chose the main factors inflecting the prediction. Using RBF neural network, the correlation parameters is adjusted to improve the model forecast accuracy. The simulation result shows the prediction accuracy is better than it does before.

articleTitle: Perception estimation of noising distortion in color components
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Many kinds of methods are used to denoising every type of noising. However in this paper we find that even the same kind of noising has different perception of image quality distortion in each color component. In order to know the perception distortion of noising in color components, several simple discrepancy measurements are calculated for each channel of different color space, such as Euclidean Distance, Manhatton Distance etc. The most popular image quality estimation, PSNR, is also computed as a reference. Quality scores gained form different methods of each channel are analysed and compared. After that we can see the sensitivity of each color components to color image noising distortion.

articleTitle: Study on the application of trunking system in the fire communication
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Except the public mobile communication system, t he trunking communication systems have become a special essential communications system. Because the distinguishing feature of one-button intercom, emergency call and multi-group scheduling and dispatching emergency functions, the trunking communication system can be used widely in the fire commanding communication. This paper introduces briefly the definition, classification and composition of trunking communication and put forward the frequency, work modes, networking modes of the fire trunking communication system. Besides, the advantages of the trunking communication system using in fire, such as the powerful dispatch function, flexible networking, large coverage, the number of multi-channel investment and low maintenance costs, etc are analyzed.

articleTitle: A formal analysis framework for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A framework is presented to model Internet of Things and analysis its running quality based on MDA, and an automatic solution is provided through a set of software tools. Firstly, modeling is executed to the instance of an Internet of things; then transforming the MARTE model to the related automaton models is done, based on the manual mapping rule from MARTE meta-model to related automaton meta-model; after the format of the automaton is adjusted from XMI to XML, the result is input into the model checking tool for the automaton and the running quality of the Internet of Things is analyzed quantitatively.

articleTitle: Large-scale network security situational awareness based on association rule research
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Association Rule is one of the main technologies of Data Mining, this paper combining with the particularity of network security, applying the association rule to large scale networks of situational awareness. Against the limitation of the classical algorithm for mining association rules Apriori algorithm, proposes an efficient algorithm to save time consumption. According to the three levels of reducing the number of non-frequent sets, avoiding calculating the items that is not existed and reducing the database redundancy items to improve the Apriori algorithm, saving lots of time and space in the algorithm process. Experiments results show that this algorithm can quickly and effectively mining association rules, and help to identify potential, malicious attacks, safeguard the overall network security situation.

articleTitle: Application and practice of WAP platform in educational service system
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The development of mobile communicational technology and internet makes mobile equipment can access conveniently the internal information in a unitive content format. The enormous information resources and the rapid popularize of mobile terminal makes the appliance of WAP have huge development potential. The article elaborates the system flow and achievement methods based on WAP platform in educational service system. The purpose is to improve college educational management efficiency and strengthen its modernization and informatization.

articleTitle: Study on force analysis of single buttress filling slag dam
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Through analyzing single buttress filling slag dam structure's mechanical characteristics in construction process and operating process, this paper adopts finite element method to carry out structural analysis for single buttress filling slag dam of Longxia irrigated area. Deducing distribution law of the dam's stress and displacement in construction process and operating process. Analysis results show that, single buttress filling slag dam of Longxia irrigated area is reasonable, it meets the requirements for design. The analysis results provide a certain reference for design and construction of single buttress filling slag dam.

articleTitle: Stability analysis and study of space grid structure
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Grid structure is a common structure form of long-span roof. It has many advantages such as beautiful shape, saving steel, big spatial stiffness, etc, in engineering at home and abroad, this roof structure has been widely used, such as large gymnasium, airdrome, exhibition hall, showplace, industry workshop, etc. This paper establishes a three-dimensional space model of square pyramid space grids structures by using the finite element method, calculates and analyses the first ten order buckling mode and critical load of this space grid structure, studies the characteristics of each order buckling mode. Research results provide some theoretical significance and application value of stability design for space grid structure.

articleTitle: The evolution of user service based on cloud computing in the university digital library
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Cloud computing technology is lead into the library field from 2009, and receives considerable attention. It brings a great shake to construction of university digital library. Cloud computing can resolve some problems about digital library, at the meanwhile, it brings changes in the fields of infrastructure, software use and platform also. The author thinks these changes will lead university library to reshape and reformation in user services.

articleTitle: Study on transmission characteristic of the PRDGS with different dielectric constants
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Periodic rectangle defected ground structure (PRDGS) is a class of frequency selective surfaces (FSS) and it can be widely applied in microwave circuits in order to obtain high performance circuits. The influence on transmission characteristic of PRDGS is calculated by the finite difference time domain method (FDTD) when the PRDGS has the different dielectric constants and the different rectangle unit sizes. The center frequency of stopband can be minimized and the width of stopband and the deepness of stopband are kept constant when the dielectric constants increase and the rectangle unit sizes remain constant. The width of stopband and the deepness of stopband can increase and the center frequency of stopband remains constant with increasing the rectangle unit sizes when the dielectric constants are kept constant. The results obtained through using the FDTD reach an excellent agreement with the ones using the equivalent circuit model method about the center frequency of stopband, and the mean relative calculation error doesn't exceed 1.72%. The helpful conclusion given in the paper can be served as a powerful tool to analyze and design the PRDGS.

articleTitle: Underwater range-gated laser imaging system design with video enhancement processing
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Range-gated laser imaging technology as a way of underwater detection featuring long detecting distance has a very wide range of applications in underwater exploration, reconnaissance, rescue and other fields. Digital image enhancement algorithm has been proved to have a significant effect to further improve the image quality of underwater range-gated laser imaging system. Based on lab's previous research on underwater range-gated laser imaging technology, we realize the local non-linear enhancement algorithm on FPGA hardware platform, which obtained real-time underwater laser range-gated imaging enhancement. Experiments were carried out in 18m long pipes full of water to compare and analyze several enhancement algorithms together. The results showed that the local non-linear enhancement algorithm in the paper significantly improved image quality compared to the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Optimization of operation for the power system considering the uncertainties of wind power and load output
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a new chance constrained model to solve the optimal operation considering the uncertainties of wind power and load output. In conventional methods, the hourly load and wind power must be forecasted in advance. However, actually there are always errors in these forecast value. Considering the uncertainty of wind power and load, different models are adopted according to their different characteristics. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, the optimal dispatch is performed in a simplified generation system. The result shows that a proper operating can be reached with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Vulnerability assessment of geological hazards based on geo-rough space and GIS
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: With geo-rough space theory and GIS technology, the study area is divided into regular grid cells, vulnerability assessment of geological hazards indexes system and vulnerability knowledge representation system and decision table in study area are designed. On this basis, specific algorithms for assessment indexes system optimization and weights confirmation are constructed. So that the vulnerability quantitative scores are calculated, and the vulnerability gradation is classified, that is, high vulnerability, medium vulnerability, low vulnerability and very low vulnerability four grades. To achieve visualization of assessment results, GIS is used to accomplish zoning mapping.

articleTitle: A data transmission method for towed line array
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) with towed line array, puts forward a method of data transmission of towed line array. Introduced the structure of data transmission node of towed line array, and completed the design of the transmitting and receiving node HOT Link controller. Aiming at the UUV using data processing platform is ADSP TS101, the communication protocol of TS101 link port designed using FPGA. This makes the HOT Link received data through data processing of link port transmission to the TS101's processor. It has proved that this method can realize high efficient transmission for towed line array.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of air-to-ground weapon launcher detector of a certain airplane
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Under the future high-tech war mode, the strength of the air combat effectiveness have become one of the main factors to win, and further, the fast support capability for the aviation equipment has played a decisive role in the improvement of air combat effectiveness. A certain type of airplane has a variety of air-to-ground weapon launchers. Existing test methods are time-consuming and laborious, and the test results are not accurate and intuitive. Therefore, design and implementation of air-to-ground weapon launcher detector of the certain airplane has important practical significance as well as military value. Based on analysis of testing requirements, this study chooses the reasonable scheme, designs a power supply module and a signal conditioning circuit, builds a comprehensive testing platform based on PC/104 embedded computer under the development environment, VC++6.0. Applications prove that, with advanced technology, rational design and simple operating, the test system can reliably detect the missile launchers, and has high accuracy and short time detection, and effectively guarantees the combat and training missions.

articleTitle: Active control scheme for reactive generation of Doubly Fed induction generator
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: With the capacity of wind power connected to the grid growing, the grid voltage stability problem is attracting attention. Aiming at the grid voltage stability, this paper present an active control scheme for reactive power based on the stator-flux-oriented vector control strategy of doubly-fed induction generator. That is when the grid voltage drop or rise, the generator increases or decreases the reactive power output automatically. Using Matlab tools for simulation studies verified that the scheme can greatly alleviates the grid voltage instability problem.

articleTitle: A study about cybermediary types in the e-business environment
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Supply chain management shows some new trends in the e-business environment. A new kind of intermediary - cybermediary, which only operates in the virtual environments, has emerged in many industries. According to what role played in a virtual supply chain, these cybermediaries could be classified by five types: informational, transactional, assurance, logistical and customization. Combining the roles with their positions in a supply chain (in terms of their attitude to customers and suppliers), a two-dimensional model is developed to present their types. Then, case studies of several online intermediaries are showed to illustrate the model.

articleTitle: Affinity propagation algorithm in WLAN network deployment
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The coverage region of WLAN network is limited compare with cell phone system such as GSM and WCDMA. The favorable area to deploy WLAN is the area which has strong demand for wireless network. How to identify the needs and guide the deployment of WLAN, that isn't a easy issue. It will waste the investment if we deploy the WLAN in improper places. This paper proposes a solution which can collect customer feedback with the help of smart phone client software and affinity propagation algorithm is applied to determine which region should be deploy first according to giant user feedback from that client software. Actual results show that the method is feasible and effective. It can significantly improve the accuracy of deployment of WLAN and efficiency of operations.

articleTitle: A fast segmentation algorithm of SAR oil slick with an improved watershed
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) works by collecting the polarized electromagnetic waves returns from many radar pulses and processing them into a single radar image, which can work all-day and all-weather, and play a significant role in the detection of the oil slick. There' re speckle noise and the inconsistencies of overall gray level in SAR image, which brings a lot of interference in SAR images' segmentation. This paper proposed a fast segmentation algorithm with an improved watershed, which has characteristics of segmenting quickly and high accuracy. The method firstly studies on SAR images' enhancement method with Speckle Reducing Anisotropic Diffusion (SRAD) to suppress speckle noise, and then marks foreground and background with a self-adaptive block threshold methods to eliminate the impact of the inconsistencies of overall gray level, finally obtains a continuous closed boundary of oil slick using watershed. We demonstrate through several examples the effectiveness of the algorithm in splitting SAR oil slick.

articleTitle: Martian minerals components at Gale crater detected by MRO CRISM hyperspectral images
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Gale Crater on Mars has the layered structure of deposit covered by the Noachian/Hesperian boundary. Mineral identification and classification at this region can provide important constrains on environment and geological evolution for Mars. Although Curiosity rove has provided the in-situ mineralogical analysis in Gale, but it restricted in small areas. Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM) aboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) with enhanced spectral resolution can provide more information in spatial and time scale. In this paper, CRISM near-infrared spectral data are used to identify mineral classes and groups at Martian Gale region. By using diagnostic absorptions features analysis in conjunction with spectral angle mapper (SAM), detailed mineral species are identified at Gale region, e.g., kaolinite, chlorites, smectite, jarosite, and northupite. The clay minerals' diversity in Gale Crater suggests the variation of aqueous alteration. The detection of northupite suggests that the Gale region has experienced the climate change from moist condition with mineral dissolution to dryer climate with water evaporation. The presence of ferric sulfate mineral jarosite formed through the oxidation of iron sulfides in acidic environments shows the experience of acidic sulfur-rich condition in Gale history.

articleTitle: A multi-emitter location method based on DOA by position information field
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To deal with the fusion failure problem of multiple location points in case of multiple emitters, a new location method by position information field (PIF) is presented. Firstly, the location precision by measuring two-dimensional directions is analyzed, and the covariance matrix of position error is deduced. Then, through the choice of different kernel functions the emitter PIF function is constructed. The position and number of emitters are estimated through grid searching technique. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the method on multi-emitter location and better location performance of the Gaussian type kernel function.

articleTitle: Development of coal mine safety supervision system of methane monitoring substation
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Coal mine methane monitoring substation is an important component of coal mine production safety monitoring system, it and flameproof and intrinsically safe power supply and a variety of mine sensors together, monitor and control for environment parameters of mine remember parameters at the central station management. In RS485 communication system for data exchange means, so compared to the traditional monitoring system, there are obvious advantages in wiring, data transmission error. Performance of methane monitoring substation based on the reliable, stable operation, high efficiency of data transmission, monitoring of the environment in a timely and effective. On the safety production of coal mine, and play a certain role.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive hydraulic test bed computer data acquisition and automatic control
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive hydraulic test bed computer automatic control system based on industrial personal computer and programmable logic controller. The system mainly consists of hydraulic test data acquisition, data processing and test process automatic control through communication between PC and lower machine.

articleTitle: Review of structural equation modeling (SEM) applications
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is a statistical method that states the relation between observation variables and latent variables or among the latent variables by linear equation system. Currently, SEM is being used widely in many fields. The article presents the applications of SEM in recent years so as to give help for people to study and use it further.

articleTitle: A programmable DCO-based digital clock multiplier and divider
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A programmable DCO-based digital clock multiplier and divider is presented in this paper. The multiplication ratio M and division ratio D can be programmed from 2 to 32, and 1 to 32, respectively. The proposed architecture uses a coarse tune circuit to reduce the lock time and a phase maintenance mechanism to overcome the process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations. With a new switching control scheme is employed in the digitally controlled oscillator (DCO), the clock generator achieves similar jitter performance as conventional MDLL. The frequency range of the input and output clock are 1 ~ 270 MHz and 15 ~ 400 MHz, respectively. This clock generator is implemented in TSMC 0.13-μm CMOS technology. The measured cycle-to-cycle timing jitter at 400 MHz is 8.4ps (rms) and 117 ps (pk-pk) with a power consumption of 24 mW at a 1.5-V power supply.

articleTitle: Molecular modeling of alkyl hydroxamates as a highly selective flotation collectors for oxidized copper mineral
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Quantum chemical calculations have been employed to understand the nature of interaction between alkyl hydroxamates and oxidized copper ore. The Material Studio 6.0 program (Accelrys, USA) has been used to model the surface-reagent interaction. As presented in the following sections, trends predicted on the basis of theoretically computed interaction energies correlate quite well with our own experimental microflotation results as well as with those available in the published literature.

articleTitle: Towards a mobile Peer-to-Peer routing method based on power-aware and ant colony optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) technology under wireless environment is now attracting more and more attention with development of wireless communication technologies and handheld device performance. Some ant colony (AC) optimization methods on mobile P2P network can adapt topology change of wireless network, but routing query does not take limited power problem of handheld devices into account. The paper presents a mobile P2P routing method based on power-aware and AC optimization. It introduces node device power sensing in routing selection, thus balancing load of whole mobile P2P network and prolong duration of network to maximum. Simulation experiment results show that the policy has certain advantage in average end-to-end delay and network duration time, which can also optimize mobile P2P network with limited power nodes.

articleTitle: A novel design of multi-blocks light guide plate for dimming edge-type LED backlight
publicationTitle: 2013 2nd International Symposium on Instrumentation and Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: With the enhancement of mobile devices features, to reduce the power consumption and extend the battery duration is a big challenge. To reduce power consumption and enhance the image display quality in the mobile devices, a novel structure of Multi-blocks Light Guide Plate (LGP) in the edge-type backlight module is proposed in this paper. The novel structure of LGP limits the backlight in one block and the brightness of each block can be dynamic controlled. Moreover, the users of mobile devices can set the “Clipping Threshold” themselves according to their needs.
